subject: CLAIM air-compute-opus (URGENT D8F18H): air/air_to_nir.c translate_callee ptr-offset arg (~l.4139-4143, 3 lines) + runtime_pipeline.inc tegu_compute_air_source_new stage-input condition
body: D8F18H = MPSImage.framework default.metallib (MPSGaussianBlur). Two causes: (1) runtime_pipeline.inc refuses whenever the descriptor carries a stageInputDescriptor object (has_stage_input=1 even with ZERO attributes; m2v metadata is byte-identical with/without it) -> refuse only for linked functions or real stage-in attributes; (2) after that the AIR frontend still refuses it: 'a pointer loaded from memory' because the texture pointer is stored into an alloca'd TextureWriter in the caller and loaded in the callee _MPSGaussianBlurTexture::sample through a pointer arg whose CONSTANT scratch offset travels as a load_param, so pslot_load cannot key it. Fix: a caller-constant offset is rebuilt as the same constant in the callee (param still passed). Also: SpringBoard crash = MPSLibrary.mm:550 failed assertion on the nil pipeline (MPS asserts, not our code); our refusal path returns nil+NSError correctly.
